## Core Mission & Architecture
Arenova designs and deploys resilient, deterministic AI automation systems for modern enterprises. We automate internal operations, outbound sales acquisition, and 24/7 customer triage so organizations eliminate manual clerical friction and scale revenue predictably.

## Primary Service Tiers & Pricing

### 1. Sales & Outreach Engine ($999/month; 15% discount quarterly)
- Dedicated cold email infrastructure (15+ warmed secondary domains, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, custom tracking domain).
- Multi-channel sequences across Cold Email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp.
- AI hyper-personalization & B2B lead enrichment (Clay, Apollo).
- Direct calendar booking & CRM deal pipeline synchronization (target 20–40+ qualified calls/month).

### 2. Business & Operations Automation ($1,999/month; 15% discount quarterly)
- End-to-end workflow orchestration (Make.com, n8n, Zapier Enterprise, custom webhooks).
- Bi-directional synchronization across CRM, ERP, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Google Workspace.
- Document & invoice extraction AI to accounting (QuickBooks, Xero, Stripe).
- Internal company knowledge assistant and automated client onboarding / contract generation.

### 3. Autonomous Enterprise ($3,499/month; 15% discount quarterly)
- Full Sales & Outreach + Business & Operations suite plus 24/7 Autonomous AI Frontdesk.
- Performance marketing conversion funnels (Meta & Google Ads routing & attribution).
- Custom AI agent development for proprietary SOPs and multi-department orchestration.
- Dedicated Fractional Systems Architect, priority 2-hour SLA, HIPAA/GDPR alignment.

### 4. Standalone / Add-on: 24/7 Autonomous AI Frontdesk ($490/month)
- Inbound voice telephony, WhatsApp Business API, SMS, and web chat triage under 15 seconds.
- Zero-hallucination guardrails anchored in deterministic schemas.
- Direct booking into Calendly, Acuity, Cliniko, Dentrix, ServiceTitan, and CRMs.
